name: The [Profession] Debut Manifesto
niche: any person launching a personal brand / creator account in a specific field (finance, fitness, law, cooking, etc.) who wants a dramatic trailer-style intro
description: A talking-head delivers a line-by-line self-introduction — a bold audience call-out, name reveal, credential, and outrageous ambition — with each beat punched by a single giant word overlay and separated by real cinematic b-roll cuts, resolving into a dramatic music montage, a detail triptych, an optional comedic follow-CTA, and a full-screen title card.

musicSlot.name: dramatic-music
musicSlot.instructions: A tense, building cinematic/trailer track. Should swell right as the spoken intro ends and carry the montage. Leave blank to use the format's own default score.

speakingTakeSlot.name: speaking-take
speakingTakeSlot.instructions: One continuous take of all your lines, straight to camera. Say each line clearly with a brief pause between them — the office background, cutaways, and montage are added for you automatically.

identitySlot.name: identity-photos
identitySlot.instructions: 5+ clear, well-lit photos of your face and body, wearing dark solid-colour clothing (avoid light-coloured trousers) — standing (arms crossed), a close-up, a side/three-quarter angle, and at least one seated pose. These are automatically turned into real studio and couch shots in Kumar's cinematic style, so you don't have to film them yourself.

slots.name: hook-clip
slots.instructions: Sit at a desk, hands steepled, and say slowly and gravely: 'This is a message to all [your audience]' — e.g. 'to all finance pros', 'to all personal trainers'. Deliver it like a threat, not a greeting. Lighting/background are replaced automatically — just say the line.

phrases: This is a message to all

generation.shot: silhouette, arms crossed, full body, on a white studio backdrop
generation.posePrompt: Standing, arms crossed over the chest, facing the camera directly, full body visible from head to shoe. Weight centered, shoulders back, confident stance. Subject occupies approximately 80% of the frame height, centered in the frame with even margin left and right.

slots.name: name-clip
slots.instructions: Same desk framing, calm and confident. Say: 'My name is [your name].' Pause on your name so the big word can hit.

generation.shot: dark side-profile silhouette on a white studio backdrop, hand to chin
generation.posePrompt: Standing in strict side profile to the camera, one hand raised to the chin in a thoughtful pose, full body visible from head to shoe. Subject occupies approximately 80% of the frame height, centered in the frame.

slots.name: credential-clip
slots.instructions: Same setup. State your background in one short phrase: 'I'm a [credential]' — e.g. 'a retired accountant', 'a former lawyer'. Land hard on the key title word.

generation.shot: moody silhouette seated on a dark leather chesterfield sofa
generation.posePrompt: Seated ON the chesterfield sofa, weight visibly compressing the seat cushion; the cushion and armrest partially OCCLUDE the thighs and hip; back resting against the tufted backrest; both feet planted on the floor; hands resting on thighs. Scale anchored to the sofa — head below the top of the backrest line. Contact shadow pooled under the thighs at the cushion junction and at the feet.

slots.name: claim-clip
slots.instructions: Same dark desk. Deliver your grand, slightly over-the-top mission in one breath: 'And I'm gonna [take over / become the biggest X in the world]'. Escalate your intensity toward the end.

generation.shot: three stacked detail panels: eyeglasses close-up, hands with cash, dress shoes

subShots.shot: extreme close-up of eyes, real footage crop
close-up of hands counting a stack of hundred dollar bills, dramatic lighting
close-up of polished dress shoes on a dark wood floor, dramatic lighting

slots.name: montage-clip
slots.instructions: Generated automatically from your identity photos in Kumar's cinematic style (backlit silhouette, moody, high contrast), reusing the beat shots earlier in the video plus two fresh cuts. Supply your own clip here instead if you'd rather film this shot yourself.

generation.shot: a rapid silent montage of moody silhouette poses

subShots.shot: reused arms-crossed silhouette, opposite push direction
hands-in-pockets silhouette on a white studio backdrop
subShots.posePrompt: Standing three-quarter to camera, both hands resting in trouser pockets, relaxed but composed posture, full body visible from head to shoe. Subject occupies approximately 80% of the frame height.

subShots.shot: reused profile silhouette, opposite push direction

subShots.posePrompt: Extreme close-up on the head and shoulders, facing slightly away from camera, strong rim light tracing the back of the head and shoulder line. Head and shoulders fill most of the frame.

subShots.shot: reused seated silhouette, opposite push direction

slots.name: cta-clip
slots.instructions: Optional bonus beat. Break the serious tone completely: bright, normal lighting, a partner/friend/family member appears with you and says the ask warmly and a little jokingly: '[This person] wants to be famous, so please follow him/her.' End on a candid laugh or playful beat. Leave blank to skip this beat.

generation.shot: full-body editorial portrait, lit, on a soft vignette backdrop
generation.posePrompt: Standing confidently, arms crossed, facing the camera directly, full body visible from head to shoe. Natural, relaxed editorial stance, fully and evenly lit. Subject occupies approximately 52% of the frame height, centered, with clear space above the head and below the feet for title text.

slots.name: debut-title
slots.instructions: The title-card text, e.g. "[NAME]'S DEBUT". Keep it short and dramatic, ALL CAPS.
